import datetime,hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd()
rr=ROOT/'learnings/policy_tuning/RobotLab-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-LW-wheel-Roa-v0/2026-10-02_14-30-02'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'.agents/skills/monitor-tune-isaaclab-training/scripts'))
from evidence_provenance import write_bytes,encode
from record_tuning_experience import validate_event,validate_effective_config_binding,validate_event_evidence
def ref(p):
 p=pathlib.Path(p)
 return {'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
pp=rr/'evidence/source/late-checkpoint-comparison-20261003-001-preflight.json'
assert ref(pp)['sha256']=='59f59fa867dc9724a8755cd4e4da48e27ecafc682cd937e56bc015e822550824'
pre=json.loads(pp.read_bytes())
ep=rr/'evidence/training/late-checkpoint-comparison-execution-20261003-001.json'
ex=json.loads(ep.read_bytes());assert ex['all_completed'] and len(ex['receipts'])==3
gp=rr/'evidence/analysis/late-checkpoint-comparison-20261003-001/metrics.json'
assert ref(gp)['sha256']=='c30f7d2f8909902230097c68d8d86d2f6a99265f9dc1a9296a3639f602b6ae57'
group=json.loads(gp.read_bytes());validated=[]
for receipt in ex['receipts']:
 step=receipt['checkpoint'];cp=pre['contracts'][str(step)]
 assert receipt['all_completed'] and ref(receipt['batch']['path'])==receipt['batch']
 m=json.loads(pathlib.Path(receipt['batch']['path']).read_bytes())
 assert m['status']=='sealed' and len(m['cases'])==6 and all(c['status']=='completed' for c in m['cases'])
 evp=pathlib.Path(receipt['event']['event_path'])
 assert ref(evp)['sha256']==receipt['event']['sha256']
 ev=json.loads(evp.read_bytes());validate_event(ev)
 cfg=validate_effective_config_binding(rr.parents[1],ev)
 check=validate_event_evidence(rr.parents[1],ev,current_config=cfg)
 assert check['event_evidence_complete'] and not check['outcome_evidence_complete'],check
 assert ev['event_type']=='evaluation_batch' and ev['event_id']=='batch-'+cp['batch_id']
 matching=[]
 for path in (rr/'events').glob('*.json'):
  event=json.loads(path.read_bytes())
  if event.get('event_id')==ev['event_id']:matching.append(path)
 assert len(matching)==1,matching
 for case in m['cases']:
  r=json.loads(pathlib.Path(case['result']['path']).read_bytes())
  assert r['status']=='completed' and r['telemetry_status']=='complete' and not r['missing_required_signals']
  assert r['outputs']['video'] is None and r['duration_steps']==case['scenario']['duration_steps']
 validated.append({'checkpoint':step,'batch':receipt['batch'],'event':ref(evp),'validation':check,'cases':6,'steps':sum(c['scenario']['duration_steps'] for c in m['cases'])})
for label in ['manifest','metrics','static']:
 item=pre['reuse_final'][label];assert ref(item['path'])==item
for section in ['native_metrics','static_metrics','plots']:
 for item in group[section].values():assert ref(item['path'])==item
plan=pathlib.Path(group['analysis_source']['path'])
assert ref(plan)==group['analysis_source']
while True:
 x=json.loads(plan.read_bytes())
 if 'python' in x:assert hashlib.sha256(x['python'].encode()).hexdigest()==x['sha256']
 if 'prior_draft' not in x:break
 assert ref(x['prior_draft']['path'])==x['prior_draft'];plan=pathlib.Path(x['prior_draft']['path'])
changed=[p for p,h in pre['protected_files'].items() if ref(p)['sha256']!=h]
assert not changed,changed
for o in group['overview'].values():assert ref(o['checkpoint']['path'])==o['checkpoint']
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip();assert head==pre['HEAD']
nav=(rr/'index.md').read_text()
old_ids=[]
for p in pre['protected_files']:
 path=pathlib.Path(p)
 if path.name=='manifest.json' and path.parent.parent==rr/'evaluations':old_ids.append(path.parent.name)
for batch_id in old_ids+[pre['contracts'][str(s)]['batch_id'] for s in [35000,40000,45000]]:assert batch_id in nav,batch_id
processes=[]
for p in pathlib.Path('/proc').glob('[0-9]*/cmdline'):
 try:argv=[b.decode(errors='replace') for b in p.read_bytes().split(b'\0') if b]
 except (FileNotFoundError,PermissionError,ProcessLookupError):continue
 if any(pathlib.Path(a).name in ['train.py','evaluate_policy.py'] for a in argv):
  processes.append({'pid':int(p.parent.name),'argv':argv})
assert not processes,processes
gpu=subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,memory.used','--format=csv,noheader'],text=True).strip()
result={'version':1,'observed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'group_metrics':ref(gp),'execution':ref(ep),
 'validated_batches':validated,'new_native_cases':18,'new_native_steps':sum(v['steps'] for v in validated),
 'new_static_input_vectors':group['integrity']['new_static_input_vectors'],'old_policy_inference_count':0,
 'protected_file_count':len(pre['protected_files']),'protected_files_unchanged':True,'four_checkpoint_hashes_verified':True,
 'old_navigation_links_preserved':old_ids,'HEAD':head,'git_status':subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short'],text=True),
 'active_train_or_eval_processes':processes,'previous_training_pid_absent':not pathlib.Path('/proc/574265').exists(),
 'gpu':gpu,'source':{'python':VERIFY_SOURCE,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(VERIFY_SOURCE.encode()).hexdigest()},
 'assessment':'descriptive comparison; no approved acceptance or convergence criteria','convergence':'indeterminate',
 'exported':False,'source_or_parameters_changed':False}
assert result['new_native_steps']==90000 and result['new_static_input_vectors']==148470
out=write_bytes(rr/'evidence/training/late-checkpoint-comparison-postflight-20261003-001.json',encode(result))
print(json.dumps({'stage':'late_comparison_verified','postflight':out,'new_cases':18,'new_native_steps':90000,'new_static_vectors':148470,'all_required_motion_telemetry_complete':True,'protected_unchanged':len(pre['protected_files']),'active_train_or_eval_processes':processes,'gpu':gpu}),flush=True)
